title: Questionnaire-to-Implementation Translator and Prioritized Remediation Sprint Planner
creator: Laura Chen
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit long security and compliance questionnaires (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor RFIs) that are expensive for Redwood to triage manually. Current intake yields a backlog of ambiguous asks, duplicated evidence requests, and ad-hoc routing to engineering/legal.

Goal: Build a translator that converts a raw questionnaire or RFI into: (1) a normalized set of discrete implementation tasks with owners and estimated effort, (2) a prioritized remediation queue scored by business impact and legal/regulatory risk, and (3) automatically generated evidence templates and suggested SLAs for responses. The output should be exportable as a sprint plan (CSV/Linear import) and visible in the Console for account teams.

Scope of this ticket: Deliver the product definition, scoring heuristic, UX wireframes for the Console intake card, and sample templates for SOC2/ISO and GDPR DPA asks. Implementation work (backend parsing and Linear import) will be delivered in follow-up ENG tickets.

Non-goals: Full automated legal sign-off, vs. proposal to surface prioritized tasks and prefilled evidence; not building an LLM-answering agent for legal responses in this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Product spec reviewed and approved by PM, Legal, and Security
Scoring heuristic documented with example calculations for 10 sample questionnaires
Console intake wireframes (desktop + mobile) showing: parsed ask list, priority score, suggested owner, SLA, and 'Create Sprint' export button
Three evidence template bundles created (SOC2 controls, ISO annex, GDPR DPA clauses) and linked in spec
Playbook for account managers describing when to accept automated recommendations vs. escalate to Legal
Integration handshake defined for ENG: output schema (CSV/Linear import) and keystone fields (ask_id, priority_score, owner, estimate_points, evidence_bundle)
notes: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff meeting: aligned with Legal (Sanjay Rao) and Security (Priya Nair). Legal emphasized that 'translation' must preserve verbatim questionnaire text and map to control families, not paraphrase for commitments.

2026-03-04 - Prototype algorithm: three-factor score = (Customer Tier Weight * 0.5) + (Regulatory Risk * 0.3) + (Implementation Effort Inverse * 0.2). Discussed adding a 'reputation risk' multiplier for strategic accounts.
2026-03-05 - Design review: DES-421 suggested inline evidence preview and a lightweight 'accept recommendation' CTA; agreed to include an expand/collapse per-ask detail panel.
2026-03-07 - PM review: adjusted priority to P1 given recurring enterprise requests causing escalations. Decided target MVE: translators for SOC2/ISO and GDPR; HIPAA as follow-up.

2026-03-09 - Legal feedback: require audit-trail metadata for every generated recommendation (source questionnaire ID, parser version, reviewer), must be surfaced in Console and included in exported sprint CSV.
2026-03-10 - Pre-sprint planning: assigned engineering owner (ENG-1842) to build parser output schema; scheduled spike to evaluate LLM-assisted extraction vs. rule-based mapping.
Links: PRD draft https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_example, Wireframes Figma https://www.figma.com/file/example, Sample questionnaire bucket https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example
implementation_notes: High-level translator outputs: ask_id, source_text, canonical_control_id, severity_label (legal|privacy|ops), priority_score (0-100), suggested_owner_role (Security/Platform/PS/Legal), estimate_points (Linear), evidence_bundle_id, confidence_score. Export format: CSV with header mapping for Linear import. Parser must keep original text and provide mapping provenance.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-reliance on automated mapping may miss contractual nuance -> Mitigation: include 'Requires Legal Review' flag and conservative default scores
Risk: False negatives on sensitive controls (HIPAA) -> Mitigation: start with high-sensitivity families behind feature flag and human-in-the-loop validation
Risk: Ambiguous ownership across Product/Infra/PS -> Mitigation: suggested_owner_role and escalation link to Account Lead in Console
next_steps: Finalize scoring rubric with Legal by 2026-03-12
Design high-fidelity Console component and export flow (DES-421 follow-up) by 2026-03-17
Kick engineering spike to evaluate parsing approaches (LLM vs rules) and deliver tech recommendation (ENG-1842) by 2026-03-20
Draft account manager playbook and training slides for rollout in Q2
